tools.name: count_text
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a word count, character count (with or without spaces), sentence or paragraph count, reading or speaking time, readability, or keyword density for text they provide, including essay counts without citations, quotes, headings, or the reference list. Pass the text exactly

tools.name: check_length_limits
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know whether text fits a limit: an essay minimum or maximum word count, a custom character limit, or platform limits for X/Twitter (280 weighted), Threads, Bluesky, LinkedIn, Instagram captions, SEO title tags, meta descriptions, or SMS segments. Returns pass or fail,

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: count_text, check_length_limits · Private data: count_text · Public sink: check_length_limits.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: count_text, check_length_limits · Private data: count_text · Public sink: check_length_limits

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
